gaps: Every breath-one member placed the new capacity inside the forgetter, and each turned out to be layered: a binding layer goes (potentiations, foreign contrasts, stale evidence, instances, microstates, identity marks, autonomy) while a carrier layer stays (room, categories, recent evidence, a rule, invariants, a genome, a partner). Grudge with a half-life broke the pattern: the capacity appeared in a relationship, and it seemed to matter whether the other player could tell the grudge had expired. That produced the changed question: what must survive, and for whom must the erasure be visible?
accepted: Night gardener: sleep weakens the synapses the day strengthened, so that tomorrow's learning has range to move in, whereas a cortex that kept every potentiation would saturate and learn nothing new (synaptic-homeostasis hypothesis, speculative); the erasure leaves only room, and nothing of the particular is kept.

Narrowing ear: a six-month-old distinguishes the phonemes of every language, a one-year-old has lost the foreign contrasts, and that loss tracks faster processing of the native ones; the discarded discriminations were real and exercised, and the capacity produced is categorical hearing, not merely fewer options.

Loosened grip: an estimator that discounts old evidence at a fixed rate can follow a parameter that drifts, whereas one with perfect memory converges on a stale average and becomes unable to register the change; the capacity is tracking through time, and it exists only because evidence expires.

Funes' cure: a network that memorizes its training set as a lookup can only repeat it; under weight decay the table is dislodged and a rule circuit that generalizes remains (the grokking reading, speculative); Borges's Funes cannot think because he cannot forget, and the capacity is transfer to unseen cases, impossible while the cases themselves are the answer.

Thermal amnesia: a gas that kept the memory of how it was poured would have no temperature; mixing destroys every microstate detail except the conserved quantities, and one number then describes the whole and an engine can be designed around it; what survives is exactly the invariants, and few-variable description is bought by that loss.

Blastema: a salamander's limb cells forget their tissue identity, dedifferentiate into a bud, and regrow the limb, while mammalian cells that retain their identity can only scar (Yamanaka reprogramming erases the same epigenetic record to recover pluripotency); the loss is of an identity record, and the capacity is a reopened possibility space.

Organelle by attrition: the ancestor of the mitochondrion lost most of its genome to the host nucleus, and a symbiont that kept its full genome would have remained a guest able to leave; the loss of autonomy is what made two organisms one (the Black Queen hypothesis generalizes this: losing a costly function a neighbor supplies creates obligate partnership); the capacity produced is membership in a larger unit.

Grudge with a half-life: in a noisy repeated game a player who never forgets a defection locks both players into punishment after one accident, while a player whose grudge expires after a bounded time restores cooperation; the grudge that dies into a trade route must decay faster than accidents recur, so the fertility is a ratio, not a virtue.

residue.item: Germline wipe: epigenetic marks are erased in germ cells each generation so the embryo starts totipotent and somatic marks do not inherit.
residue.why: Rejected as a separate member: the carrier (erasure of an epigenetic identity record reopening a possibility space) is Blastema's at another scale; kept as an illustrative reach of that item rather than a second entry.

residue.item: Symbol that forgot its referent: Leibniz's dx and Heaviside's operators compute faster than notation that carries its derivation at every step.
residue.why: Rejected: the derivation is detached, not lost, and a user who retains it computes no slower. This is an economy of attention, not a forgetting that produces a capacity retention blocked; it sits with the forgetful functor as a projection.

residue.item: Lost coins: bitcoins whose keys are lost make the remaining supply scarcer.
residue.why: Rejected: the loss changes a quantity, not a capacity; nothing becomes possible that was impossible while the keys existed.

gate: declared modality, recognizable distinction, defensible seriation and conditional relations
limits: Authored conceptual fieldwork in a separated mixture of registers: observed cases (narrowing, Athens, Parry-Lord, setup ceremonies, Vinland), analytical models (thermal amnesia, forgetting factor, noisy repeated games), and published but contested hypotheses (synaptic homeostasis, grokking as weight decay, Black Queen, Renan); modality is marked per item and nothing here is empirically validated by this map.

The seriation orders what an erasure leaves standing and who must see it fall; it does not order value, degree of loss, or historical sequence, and an actual forgetting may belong to several items at once.

Several items rest on causal readings that remain open (adult learners and morphological simplification; whether Vinland's non-integration was loss or indifference); the map uses them as illustrations of a carrier, not as settled history.

Projections that keep the original beside the reduced copy (the forgetful functor, notation detached from its derivation) are excluded because nothing was lost; the map does not cover abstraction as such.

Effects of events that never occurred belong to traces-of-the-unlived; every member here concerns something that existed and was then lost, and the two maps are meant to be read against each other, not merged.

gaps: Following the visibility question into language, law, and cryptography split the social members by the sign of their dependence on witnesses: Rediscoverable coast and Founding oblivion are fertile only while the loss goes unremarked, Law against remembering, Discharge, and Ceremony of ash only when it is public, and a decree that tries to enforce the first kind produces the second and restores the memory. The territory's live question therefore has two answers: for the forgetter, a fertile forgetting is a layered erasure that keeps a carrier; for others, it is an erasure whose visibility matches the direction of their dependence. Ceremony of ash is the member the first framing obscured, since its capacity lives entirely in verifiers who forgot nothing.
accepted: Fixation fade: a solver stuck on a wrong approach finds the answer after a break because the misleading retrieval route decays and a rival route can reach threshold (the forgetting-fixation account of incubation); what is lost is one path, and the capacity appears only after that path, not the problem, is forgotten.

Dead metaphor's harvest: muscle was a little mouse, and once the mouse is forgotten 'muscle memory' can be said without a rodent in it; a language grows its abstract vocabulary by forgetting its pictures, because a word still carrying its image resists combination (nobody can grasp a slippery idea while grasp is still a hand); a cliché is not a member, since its image survives and still resists.

Exceptions lost in transit: English shed case and gender where Norse and English adults could not retain each other's inflections, and fixed word order emerged, learnable by strangers (languages with many adult learners tend to simpler morphology; the causal reading is contested); nobody chose the loss, and the capacity, learnability, appears in the successors, not in the losers.

Singer's leak: an oral bard cannot store ten thousand lines verbatim, so a system of formulas develops that regenerates the poem in every performance; when recordings and literacy arrived, Lord watched the regenerative capacity die; the capacity belongs to the medium's inability to retain, not to any one singer's forgetting.

Rediscoverable coast: the sagas' Vinland never entered the charts of those who could sail, so the same coast could be discovered again, an event that mobilizes ships, funding, and names as a known coast cannot; the place is unchanged, and the capacity exists only in a population from which the record is absent.

Founding oblivion: Renan's claim that a nation requires every citizen to have forgotten Saint Bartholomew, because a founding massacre remembered by both sides keeps the 'we' from forming; the forgetting works only unremarked, and a decree or commemoration of it restores the memory; analytical and contested.

Law against remembering: after the Thirty Tyrants, Athenians swore not to recall wrongs (mē mnēsikakein) and barred prosecution for acts under the oligarchy, so former enemies could sit in one assembly; everyone still remembered, and what was erased was standing to act on the memory, by public oath.

Discharge: a bankruptcy discharge or a Mesopotamian debt cancellation erases what is owed and returns bonded households to the population that fields armies and borrows again; the erasure is itself recorded and scheduled, and lending survives because lenders can count on it; a forgetting that must be known in advance to be fertile.

Ceremony of ash: a zero-knowledge proof system's setup produces a secret that must be destroyed and seen destroyed, so participants burn hardware on camera and the system is sound if at least one of them truly forgot; every later proof rests on an erasure the verifier did not perform, and the same secret destroyed in private yields the same physical fact and no usable system.

residue.item: Second draft from ash: Carlyle rewrote the burned first volume of The French Revolution from the retained shape without the text, and the rewriting is said to have been better.
residue.why: Rejected: the carrier (a surviving gist regenerating the object without its accidents) is Funes' cure at the scale of one text, and the improvement is an anecdote; admitting it would let a mood ('loss made it better') stand in for a mechanism.

residue.item: Forward secrecy: session keys are deleted so that a later capture of the long-term key cannot open past sessions.
residue.why: Rejected as a separate member: it protects the past from the future and needs no witness, so the capacity is a retained security rather than a new possibility in others; Ceremony of ash carries the witnessed version, which is the stranger and more discriminating case.

residue.item: Forgetful functor: free objects arise as the left adjoint of a functor that forgets structure.
residue.why: Rejected and moved to the boundary case: nothing was lost; the original stays beside its image. The map admits ash, not shadows.

residue.item: Extinction learning: a conditioned fear fades with repeated safe exposure and the animal can return to the place.
residue.why: Rejected: spontaneous recovery and renewal show the fear record was retained under a new inhibitory memory; this is overwriting, not erasure, and it belongs to a map of layered memories rather than to fertile forgettings.

neighbors.left: Loosened grip: an estimator that discounts old evidence at a fixed rate can follow a parameter that drifts, whereas one with perfect memory converges on a stale average and becomes unable to register the change; the capacity is tracking through time, and it exists only because evidence expires.
neighbors.right: Funes' cure: a network that memorizes its training set as a lookup can only repeat it; under weight decay the table is dislodged and a rule circuit that generalizes remains (the grokking reading, speculative); Borges's Funes cannot think because he cannot forget, and the capacity is transfer to unseen cases, impossible while the cases themselves are the answer.
neighbors.separating_case: A thermostat's log in a room whose heat source is steady: discounting old readings only adds noise, while collapsing all readings into a setpoint rule is fertile, so Funes' cure applies and Loosened grip does not. Move the room next to a furnace that drifts: the rule from all readings goes stale and only the discounting estimator tracks, so Loosened grip applies and the attrition into a rule is what fails. Same erasure, opposite verdicts, decided by whether the world holds still.

checks.boundary_case: The forgetful functor, which maps groups to their underlying sets and whose left adjoint produces free groups, is tempting because a universal object is literally born from a forgetting. It is out because nothing was lost: the original stays beside its image, and the 'forgetting' is a projection that can be undone by looking back. The map admits ash, not shadows; extinction learning is excluded on the same ground from the other side, since spontaneous recovery of the fear shows the record was retained.
checks.form_inference: The seriation places Founding oblivion beside Law against remembering as if they were a gradient; the edge between them says the step is destructive: announcing a drift-forgetting converts it into a decree-forgetting and restores the grievance, so the two are incompatible rather than adjacent degrees. The Loosened grip / Funes' cure edge is a fork the line hides: one erasure, fertile or lossy according to the world's stationarity. The Grudge → Law against remembering → Discharge chain is a passage between levels (individual ratio, collective oath, recorded institution) that no position in the list could express.
checks.target_preserved: Self-read only. Every member names a carrier from a specific loss to a specific capacity and says what survived; the strange members (an engine designed on the ashes of a gas's history, a proof system whose soundness is a burned laptop, an organism made by losing the ability to leave) were kept as stated rather than domesticated into 'letting go' or 'abstraction'.

next_crossfield_opening: Read this map against traces-of-the-unlived: Permission ash (practitioners never formed because a prohibition was expected) and Exceptions lost in transit (a grammar re-formed because inflections could not be carried) are mirror carriers; ask whether every fertile forgetting has an unlived twin in which the same capacity fails to form because the loss was anticipated rather than suffered.

gaps: The sign change at the hinge is carried on its far side by Discharge, which confused being witnessed with being foreseeable: the seventh-year release was public, foreseen, and free and dried up lending until Hillel's prozbul, while the Mesopotamian edicts were public but sudden and modern discharge is foreseeable but priced. The positive side of the hinge is therefore witnessed-but-not-forecast, and the axis 'who must see it fall' lacks a second coordinate, who may foresee it. Secondary: the `of` promised a witness for every item while the first twelve name none; the witness clause is now conditional on the capacity appearing outside the forgetter.
accepted: Night gardener: sleep downscales the synapses the day strengthened, and because the scaling is proportional the strong traces stay strong relative to the weak ones while the weakest fall below threshold and are gone, so tomorrow's learning has range and the day's signal stands out from its noise, whereas a cortex that kept every potentiation would saturate and learn nothing new (synaptic-homeostasis hypothesis, speculative); the erasure leaves a ratio and room, not the particulars, and a scaling that preserved nothing would be mere room, which the map does not count as a carrier.

Loosened grip: an estimator that discounts old evidence at a fixed rate can follow a parameter that drifts, whereas one that weights all evidence equally converges on a stale average and becomes unable to register the change; a full log kept beside the estimate changes nothing, since the capacity lives in what the estimate has let go and not in what the archive holds; the capacity is tracking through time, and it exists only because evidence expires in the estimate.

Thermal amnesia: a gas that kept the memory of how it was poured would have no temperature; mixing spreads every microstate detail into correlations no instrument can follow, leaving only the conserved quantities in reach, and one number then describes the whole and an engine can be designed around it; the detail is not destroyed but lost to access, which is why a spin echo can call dephased spins back before the loss is complete and why a gas that could still be echoed still holds extractable work rather than a temperature (analytical); what survives is exactly the invariants, and few-variable description is bought by that loss.

Blastema: a salamander's limb cells forget their differentiated state, dedifferentiate into a bud, and regrow the limb, while mammalian cells that keep their state can only scar; what the bud's cells keep is lineage, since axolotl blastema cells remember whether they came from dermis, cartilage, or muscle and do not cross (Yamanaka reprogramming erases that deeper record as well and recovers pluripotency at the price of lineage); the loss is of a state record with the lineage record left standing, and the capacity is a possibility space reopened exactly as far as the erasure went.

Dead metaphor's harvest: muscle was a little mouse, and once the mouse is forgotten 'muscle memory' can be said without a rodent in it; a language grows its abstract vocabulary by forgetting its pictures, on the reading that a word still carrying its image resists combination (analytical, unmeasured: nobody can grasp a slippery idea while grasp is still a hand); a cliché is not a member, since its image survives and still resists.

Discharge: a bankruptcy discharge or a Mesopotamian clean-slate edict erases what is owed and returns bonded households to the population that fields armies and borrows again; the erasure must be public, since a creditor who cannot see the debt fall keeps collecting, but it must not be both foreseeable and free, because lenders stop lending ahead of a release they can see coming (Deuteronomy warns against refusing loans as the seventh year nears, and Hillel's prozbul let lenders opt out once they had), so the recurring erasure is either sudden (the edicts came unannounced at accession) or priced (a discharge costs the debtor standing for years); witnessed, not forecast, is the condition.

residue.item: Rediscoverable coast: the sagas' Vinland never entered the charts of those who could sail, so the same coast could be discovered again, an event that mobilizes ships, funding, and names as a known coast cannot; the place is unchanged, and the capacity exists only in a population from which the record is absent.
residue.why: Cut on the critic's argument: the sagas were retained by the Norse and never reached the Iberians, so the capacity appears in a population where nothing was lost, which the map's own fifth boundary claim excludes; the mechanism reduces to 'a known coast cannot be discovered', and the mobilization credited to the forgetting is confounded with Iberian readiness. Nothing preserved against the critic: each repair showed the original failing on the map's own terms (bare room, equal weighting, reversible dynamics, retained lineage, a foreseeable release) rather than domesticating a strange mechanism, so all six were applied.

limits: The seriation orders what an erasure leaves standing and who must see it fall; it does not order value, degree of loss, or historical sequence, and it lacks a second coordinate the witnessed members need, who may foresee the fall and at what cost (the Fable critic's objection); an actual forgetting may belong to several items at once.
A claimed erasure is ash only if no echo can be run on it (spin-echo test, Fable critic); members whose detail is merely dephased rather than beyond access are out.
seed: A second coordinate the hinge needs: not only who must see the erasure fall but who may foresee it. Sort the witnessed members by foreseeability and cost: the Mesopotamian edict (public, sudden, free), the seventh-year release (public, foreseen, free, and it died), bankruptcy (public, foreseen, priced), the trusted-setup ceremony (public, foreseen, free, and it lives because nobody can profit from foreseeing an erasure that is not theirs). That table predicts which announced forgettings survive their announcement, and it would tell Founding oblivion and Law against remembering apart by mechanism instead of by example.
